description: Sixth round: the indexer ReLU as a BF16 clamp (packed NaN-keeping max and min) and the NaN-keeping index quantizer, against r6k's bits and time with a precise timer and r6k-against-r6k noise rows; their tests and NaN-input contracts.
argv: import os, subprocess, sys; codes = [subprocess.call([sys.executable, '/b/bench_relu6.py'])]; env = dict(os.environ, PYTHONPATH='/b' + os.pathsep + os.environ.get('PYTHONPATH', ''), SWAP='indexer=/b/indexer_clamp16_quant.py'); codes += [subprocess.call([sys.executable, '-m', 'pytest', '-q', '--noconftest', '-p', 'no:cacheprovider', '-p', 'swap_plugin', '-rfEPxX', '-k', 'indexer or mxfp4 or index_keys or quantizer', 'tests/kernels/attention/test_deepseek_v41_tilelang.py', 'tests/kernels/attention/test_deepseek_v41_tilelang_nan_inputs.py'], env=env)]; print('exit codes (bench, clamp16 + NaN-keeping quantizer tests)', codes); sys.exit(max(codes))
